subject.title: fix(ui): apply Context Profile presets via config.patch to avoid SecretRef rejection

question: Should the current-main port reject preset application while Raw JSON has unsaved edits, or merge the preset into the raw draft before advancing its base hash?
rationale: Both approaches can prevent the stale full-config draft from undoing the partial write, but the permanent Raw editor interaction contract belongs to the Control UI/config-write owners.

options.title: Gate Dirty Raw Mode
options.body: Disable preset Apply while Raw JSON is dirty and require Save or Discard first, then reload the clean raw snapshot after patching.

options.title: Merge Into Raw Draft
options.body: Parse valid dirty Raw JSON, apply the same merge patch locally, preserve unrelated edits, and reject application when the draft is invalid.

options.title: Pause The Port
options.body: Leave the PR open until the current Control UI configuration refactor stabilizes and then rebuild the fix at its final owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Gate Dirty Raw Mode
recommendation.body: Disable preset Apply while Raw JSON is dirty and require Save or Discard first, then reload the clean raw snapshot after patching.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns SecretRef-safe write semantics and post-write configuration reconciliation, matching their merged work on this boundary.
